texts.preamble: Karthikeyan vs The District Collector on 29 May, 2019 Author: Shaji P.Chaly Bench: Shaji P.Chaly In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present The Honourable Mr. Justice Shaji P.Chaly Wednesday, The 29Th Day Of May 2019 / 8Th Jyaishta, 1941 WP(C).No. 4374 of 2019 Petitioner/S: Karthikeyan, Proprietor, Nirapara Food Products, Panchikala, Poovar P.O, Thiruvananthapuram District. By Advs. Sri.Vinod Madhavan Sri.M.V.Bose Respondent/S: 1 The District Collector, Office Of The District Collector, Kollam, Pin-691 001 2 The Sub Inspector Of Police, Parippally Police Station, Kollam City, Pin-691 574 3 The District Supply Officer, Office Of The District Supply Officer, Kollam, Pin-691 001 4 The Taluk Supply Officer Office Of The Taluk Supply Officer, Kollam, Pin-691 001 R1 To R4 By Smt. B Vinitha. Gp Karthikeyan vs The District Collector on 29 May, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34601782/ 1 This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Been Finally Heard On 29.05.2019, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following: WP(C).No. 4374 of 2019 2 Judgment
texts.facts: This writ petition is filed by the petitioner, challenging seizure of food grains contained in plastic bags while in transit to the respective shops of the purchasers of rice from the petitioner, alleging it to be rationed articles. Ext.P6 FIR is registered by the Parippally Police Station, Kollam District. 2. While matters being so, petitioner has submitted Ext.P8 before the District Collector challenging the action of seizure, which is pending in File No.DCKLM/1272/2019-M8, before the District Collector. The sole relief sought for by the petitioner is adjudication of Ext.P8, also taking into account, the contentions raised by the petitioner that the District Collector has no power to entertain any aspects as per the rationing order in view of Section 97(2) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
